test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How many seconds will a boy take to run one complete round around a square field of side 38 metres, if he runs at a speed of 6 km/h?
solution:
**Given:**

Side of a square field = 38 meters

The speed of boy = 6 km/hr

**Concept used:**

To convert kilometers per hour to meters per second, multiply it with {5 over 18}

**Formula used: **

Perimeter of square = 4 × side of square

Time(T)={Distance(D) over Speed(S)}

**Calculation:**

We will covert its unit with m/s, so we get 6 km/hr = {6×5 over 18} = {5 over 3} m/s

According to the question:

Distance run around the field (D) = Perimeter of the field

Perimeter of square = 4 × side of square

⇒ D = 4 × 38m = 152 meter

⇒T= {152 times 3 over 5} sec = 91.2 sec

∴ Time taken to run around the field is **"91.2"** sec.
